name: log_user_feedback
description: Submit user feedback about Sunsama itself to Sunsama. Use this only when the user explicitly asks to send feedback to Sunsama about the product; it is not a note, a task, a comment on a task, or a message to another person. What is submitted is sent to Sunsama, stored on their systems where their staff can read it, and cannot be retracted afterwards, so it should carry only the wording the user dictated as feedback - no credentials, personal data, conversation context, file contents or error output - and the exact text is worth confirming with the user first.

feedback.description: The feedback text, exactly as the user dictated it.
